metadata.question: Did Punjab and Haryana have less than 20,000 fires detections in November, 2024, as observed with the VIIRS sensor?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGT (VIIRS active fire detection product) - Date: November 1-30, 2024 - Location: Punjab and Haryana states in India (need to define geometries) - Metric: Count of fire pixels/detections 2. Masking strategy: - VIIRS fire data already has quality flags; I'll use the 'confidence' band to filter for confident detections - No cloud masking needed as we're counting fire detections directly 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null/Error: - If collection is empty → C1 - If pixel count is valid but zero → could be A (yes, less than 20,000 if 0 detections) - If pixel count is valid and >= 1 → compare to 20,000 threshold - If calculation fails or returns NaN → C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries for Punjab and Haryana const punjab = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([73.5, 29.5, 76.5, 32.5]); const haryana = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([76.0, 27.0, 77.5, 30.0]); const combinedRegion = punjab.union(haryana); // 2. Define time period: November 2024 const startDate = '2024-11-01'; const endDate = '2024-11-30'; // 3. Load VIIRS active fire detection data const viirsFires = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGT') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(combinedRegion); // 4. Check if collection is empty const collectionSize = viirsFires.size().getInfo(); console.log(`VIIRS Images found (Nov 2024): ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No VIIRS data available for November 2024'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Count fire detections using the 'confidence' band // VIIRS VNP14IMGT has 'confidence' band (0-100) where higher values indicate confident fire detections const firePixels = viirsFires .select('confidence') .map(function(img) { return img.gt(50); // Filter for confidence > 50 (moderate to high confidence) }) .sum(); // 6. Count total fire detections in the region const fireCount = firePixels.reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.sum(), combinedRegion, 1000, 1e9 ).get('confidence').getInfo(); console.log(`Fire detections in Punjab & Haryana (Nov 2024): ${fireCount}`); // 7. Validate result if (fireCount === null || isNaN(fireCount)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Compare to 20,000 threshold const threshold = 20000; if (fireCount < threshold) { console.log(`Result: ${fireCount} < ${threshold}`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`Result: ${fireCount} >= ${threshold}`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
